integrity: Mathematical proof is given in RESULT.md and deterministic supplementary finite-dimensional checks in verify.py. The finite checks do not establish infinite-dimensional assertions. No independent scientific audit has occurred.
limitations: Finite or countable norm-square-summable Kraus families only; word-compactness is a sufficient recovery condition, not a complete classification of all equal-radius tuples. For a power-compact family only the compact powers, not necessarily the unsquared original maps, are asserted to have matching nonzero spectral multisets. Priority in older operator-ideal literature is not independently certified.
title: Power-compact Kraus families restore row–column spectral symmetry
